text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan! Holding off the Eternal Big Three,
Mejiro Ardan takes the lead! She's across the line!
The pinnacle of racing has been decided right here, right now!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Milady...
You are truly magnificent...
...I suppose "next time" will be on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I won... Me...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (I won... against the Eternal Big Three...!!)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ――Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
It's your win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Miss Oguri...!
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderful run~! I'm so glad I got to run with you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I lost, I totally lost—!
It was such a clean, refreshing defeat!
You really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Everyone...—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "—I've always thought your running was truly fascinating."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if she holds so many different kinds of brilliance within her,
how should I put it...—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It was bursting with color,
shining like delicate glassware.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. At any rate, I just wanted to tell you that your running was magnificent, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: No—it is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that...
is a great honor for me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: You really changed history, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Ardan!!
You're the symbol of this era--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's not the Big Three anymore, it's the Big Four!
Mejiro Ardan is the absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone.
And please, never forget this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My name is Mejiro Ardan.
Standing here bathed in countless radiances, the one who shines with the greatest light "now"...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Upon Fuchu, I shall carve my eternal trail of light!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Will you stay by my side and support me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy...
that all the strength in my legs is about to give out... so—

Afterward, as I supported her, we listened
together to the cheers praising Mejiro Ardan.
Before long, having given her all, she drifted off to sleep, but even after returning to the waiting room, cheers continued to echo through the venue—
